rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Built by GlassTape, this MCP server transforms natural language policy requirements into production-ready Cerbos YAML policies through an intermediate canonical policy (ICP) format. The implementation features a complete policy development workflow including generation from structured JSON or natural language, syntax validation via Cerbos CLI integration, comprehensive test suite execution, security analysis with red-team findings, and a template library covering finance, healthcare, AI safety, data access, and system administration scenarios. With air-gap capability for maximum security, built-in compliance framework support (HIPAA, GDPR, SOX, EU AI Act), and automated policy testing, it's designed for developers building secure authorization systems who need to rapidly generate, validate, and deploy access control policies with confidence.
